Annotation.String: The NvidiaHostRecovery schema describes the recovery mode state of the host processor of a computer system.

This resource shall represent the recovery mode state of a host processor that the manager can force into its USB recovery bootloader, such as the Tegra recovery mode (RCM). Recovery is entered and left with the `EnterHostRecovery`, `CheckHostRecoveryStatus`, `ExitHostRecovery`, and `AbandonUnverifiedRecoverySession` actions on the computer system that contains this resource.
An indication of whether the service that controls host recovery is running.

This property shall indicate whether the service that controls host recovery is running. If `false`, `RecoveryState`, `LastCheckStatus`, and `OperationState` shall contain `Unknown`, `RecoveryActive` and `RecoveryAttemptCount` shall be absent, and the service shall reject the host recovery actions.
An indication of whether a recovery session is active.

This property shall indicate whether a recovery session is active. A session starts when `EnterHostRecovery` resets the host into recovery. It ends when entry into recovery fails, when the host is reset or powered off, when the host is seen to leave recovery, or when `AbandonUnverifiedRecoverySession` completes.
The recovery state of the host.
This property shall contain the recovery state of the host, as correlated by the manager from the recovery requests it issued and the evidence it observed.
The result of the most recent probe for the host recovery device.
This property shall contain the result of the most recent probe for the host recovery device, made by either the `EnterHostRecovery` or the `CheckHostRecoveryStatus` action.
The host recovery operation in progress.
This property shall contain the host recovery operation in progress. The service shall reject a host recovery action while this property contains a value other than `Idle`.
The number of recovery attempts in the current attempt window.

This property shall contain the number of `EnterHostRecovery` attempts in the current attempt window since the manager last booted. The service may reject further attempts once an implementation-defined limit is reached, until the window ends.
No recovery session is tracked, or the state is not known.
This value shall indicate that no recovery session is tracked, that a session was abandoned, or that the service that controls host recovery is not running.
Recovery was requested, but entry is not confirmed.
This value shall indicate that the host was reset into recovery and that entry into recovery has not been confirmed.
The host is confirmed to be in recovery.
This value shall indicate that the host recovery device was detected, or that boot evidence confirmed entry into recovery.
Recovery was requested, but the host was not detected in recovery.
This value shall indicate that the host was reset into recovery and that the host recovery device was not detected afterwards.
A reset out of recovery was issued.
This value shall indicate that the host was reset out of recovery and has not yet been seen to boot normally.
The host was seen to leave recovery.
This value shall indicate that the host was seen to boot normally after a recovery session.
The host was powered off during a recovery session.
This value shall indicate that the host was powered off while a recovery session was active.
The service that controls host recovery is not running.
This value shall indicate that the service that controls host recovery is not running.
No probe has run.
This value shall indicate that no probe for the host recovery device has run.
The host recovery device was detected.
This value shall indicate that the most recent probe detected the host recovery device.
The host recovery device was not detected.
This value shall indicate that the most recent probe completed without detecting the host recovery device.
The probe timed out.
This value shall indicate that the most recent probe did not complete in time.
The host USB port could not be routed to the manager.
This value shall indicate that the most recent probe could not route the host USB port to the manager.
USB enumeration failed.
This value shall indicate that the most recent probe could not enumerate the USB devices on the host USB port.
The host USB port could not be routed back to the external connector.

This value shall indicate that, after the most recent probe, the host USB port could not be routed back to the external connector. The service may retry for a limited time. The value remains until a later check reports a different status, even if a retry restores the routing.
The service that controls host recovery is not running.
This value shall indicate that the service that controls host recovery is not running.
No operation is in progress.
This value shall indicate that no host recovery operation is in progress.
The host is being put into recovery.
This value shall indicate that an `EnterHostRecovery` action is in progress.
The host is being reset out of recovery.
This value shall indicate that an `ExitHostRecovery` action is in progress.
The host recovery device is being probed.
This value shall indicate that a `CheckHostRecoveryStatus` action is in progress.
The host USB port is being routed back to the external connector.
This value shall indicate that the service is routing the host USB port back to the external connector.
A recovery session is being abandoned.
This value shall indicate that an `AbandonUnverifiedRecoverySession` action is in progress.
The result of a host recovery action.
This type shall contain the result of a host recovery action and the recovery state after it completed.
The recovery state that the action resulted in.
This property shall contain the recovery state that the action resulted in.
A human-readable description of the result.
This property shall contain a human-readable description of the result of the action.
The recovery state of the host after the action.
This property shall contain the value of `RecoveryState` in the NvidiaHostRecovery resource when the action completed.
An indication of whether a recovery session is active after the action.
This property shall contain the value of `RecoveryActive` in the NvidiaHostRecovery resource when the action completed.
The result of the most recent probe after the action.
This property shall contain the value of `LastCheckStatus` in the NvidiaHostRecovery resource when the action completed.
The host recovery operation in progress after the action.
This property shall contain the value of `OperationState` in the NvidiaHostRecovery resource when the action completed.
